description: A 128-stage shift register with eight taps, bringing out the level read in 16, 32, 48, 64, 80, 96, 112 and 128 clock edges ago.

inputs.text: The level read into the register on each rising clock edge.
A rising edge shifts the register one place along and reads the level at the DATA jack into the first stage.

outputs.text: The level that was read in 16 clock edges ago.
The level that was read in 32 clock edges ago.
The level that was read in 48 clock edges ago.
The level that was read in 64 clock edges ago.
The level that was read in 80 clock edges ago.
The level that was read in 96 clock edges ago.
The level that was read in 112 clock edges ago.
The level that was read in 128 clock edges ago, after which it is lost.

notes: A logic input counts as high once it rises above 2V and does not count as low again until it falls below 0.1V; a logic output is 10V for high and 0V for low.

inputs.0:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only

a negative voltage does nothing here.
inputs.1:
high above 2V · stepped · one channel only
